pg17_pitr.quote: PostgreSQL 17 is listed in the version policy (db-versions: "PostgreSQL 17") and PITR is documented as "Select Clone from an earlier point in time. Enter a PITR time." - but no fetchable page states the base-backup + continuous-WAL-archive mechanism that E10 requires
pg17_pitr.note: [OPEN] ⚠️ UNKNOWN: E10 wants base backup + continuous WAL archive. GCP's PITR pages (pitr, backups, configure-pitr) do not state the WAL/log-archiving mechanism and no write-ahead-log sentence could be read from them, so this hard gate is answered UNKNOWN, not true. GCP is therefore ineligible until the mechanism is confirmed in writing.
